result:
All 617 tests pass, scratch files are removed, and typecheck is clean. Summary of the implementation:

- **`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`**: added `assertProjectWritable`, called from `updateIssue`, `changeIssueStatus`, `assignIssue`, and `archiveIssue` (after the existing per-row `assertNotArchived` check, so an already-archived issue still reports itself first). `moveIssue` inherits the check via `changeIssueStatus`.
- **`src/server/services/comment-service.ts`**: added `assertProjectWritable`/`assertIssueProjectWritable`, called from `createComment`, `updateComment`, and `deleteComment`.
- **`src/server/services/attachment-service.ts`**: added `assertProjectWritable`, called from `addAttachment` and `removeAttachment`.
- **`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`**: `listOverdueIssues` now inner-joins `projects` and requires the project to be live, so the overdue sweep never announces issues belonging to an archived project.

All checks reuse the existing `AlreadyArchivedError` / `assertNotArchived` from `src/lib/soft-delete.ts`, keep existing permission/self-archived precedence, and reads (issue, thread, attachments, lists, board) are untouched. Restoring a project clears `archivedAt`, which immediately lifts the freeze everywhere, including the overdue sweep — verified with throwaway tests (now removed).
